answer: Problem: cheap key farms harvest seats with no work history. Mechanism: join a 7-seat lotus ring; each seat posts a 2.40 POA plume bond and a 40-byte quill transcript (Merkle path over three finalized work txs from distinct epochs), then live-echoes a committee nonce for 12s after a 22-minute offset. Seal if six echoes land, leaves are pairwise unique, and no shared parent exists within four hops. Cost: 2.40 POA locked two epochs. Verify: path uniqueness, echo timing, parent graph. Failure: missed echo or parent collision slashes 55% and bars those addresses for five epochs.
